parole.significato: Gandhi (any major political leader who is a proponent of nonviolence)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Gujarati ગાંધી (gāndhī, “grocer, merchant”), from Sanskrit गन्ध (gandha, “perfume”). Originally, a trader in perfume.

Borrowed from Gujarati ટાંકી (ṭā̃kī, “cistern, underwater water reservour”). Etymology 1 sense 3 is a semantic loan from English tank (“armoured fighting vehicle”), see there for the sense development.
